classes.name: Crate
classes.description: A Rust crate boundary used by the portable CLI ontology projection.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: A named implementation component in the portable CLI ontology projection.

classes.name: SekaiOntology
classes.description: The sekai-ontology crate: portable ontology library and CLI tool with deterministic discovery, semantic diffing, and a read-only natural-language frontend.

classes.name: OntologySearch
classes.description: A deterministic vocabulary search over portable ontology class and relation definitions.

classes.name: OntologyDiff
classes.description: A semantic comparison of two portable ontology documents or databases.

classes.name: OntologyAsk
classes.description: A read-only natural-language interpreter that compiles supported questions into bounded ontology explain, query, find, or directory-query plans.

classes.name: DirectoryEntity
classes.description: A deterministic local filesystem directory fact identified by its normalized absolute path and assigned ontology kind.

classes.name: Directory
classes.description: The standard ontology class for a filesystem directory represented as a durable local fact.

classes.name: WorkspaceDirectory
classes.description: A directory that scopes multiple projects and their local ontologies.

classes.name: ProjectDirectory
classes.description: A project root directory with its own local ontology scope.

classes.name: DirectoryLink
classes.description: A deterministic fact connecting two directory entities, including direct parent-child containment.

classes.name: DirectoryIndexer
classes.description: The local-only scanner and persistence boundary that indexes bounded directory trees without following symlinks and optionally prunes stale facts.

classes.name: DirectoryQuery
classes.description: A bounded traversal over stored directory entities and links with explicit direction, relation, and depth options.

relations.name: provides_search
relations.description: The portable ontology CLI provides deterministic definition discovery.

relations.name: provides_diff
relations.description: The portable ontology CLI provides semantic definition comparison.

relations.name: provides_read_only_ask
relations.description: The portable ontology CLI provides a read-only natural-language frontend over typed plans.

relations.name: provides_directory_indexing
relations.description: The portable ontology CLI provides deterministic local directory indexing and subtree exchange.

relations.name: records_directory_entities
relations.description: The directory indexer records normalized directory entities as durable local facts.

relations.name: records_directory_links
relations.description: The directory indexer records deterministic links between directory entities.

relations.name: provides_directory_query
relations.description: The portable ontology CLI provides bounded traversal over directory facts.

relations.name: contains
relations.description: Direct filesystem parent-child containment between directory classes; stored directory links are traversed with bounded depth.
